messages:
sam: heads-up: deploy-bot stopped the final promote for redwood/api:6.1.0 — provenance digest mismatch observed in us-gcr mirror. holding the change window.

deploy-bot: :warning: publish-guard BLOCKED
attested_manifest=sha256:11aaff...
registry_manifest(us-gcr)=sha256:11bbff...
build_id=202603240830 cosign=present

nina: which registry exactly? we push to gcr-us and gcr-eu via the mirror pipeline. this looks like only the us mirror differs.

sam: yes, us-gcr returned a different manifest digest than the attestation. quote: "manifest stored as sha256:11bbff..."

oliver: pulling the publish logs now. attach snippet:
```
2026-03-24T08:30:10Z INFO uploader: multipart push complete
2026-03-24T08:30:12Z INFO mirror: copying manifest to us-gcr
2026-03-24T08:30:13Z WARN mirror: normalized layer digest (strip padding)
2026-03-24T08:30:14Z INFO attestor: created attestation (manifest=sha256:11aaff...)
2026-03-24T08:30:15Z INFO registry(us-gcr): stored manifest sha256:11bbff...
2026-03-24T08:30:15Z ERROR provenance: attested vs registry mismatch
```

pete: hmm, mirror normalization again. If the mirror normalizes a blob it ends up changing the manifest content/order. Attestations point to pre-normalization digest.

qa-bot: note: canary tests were green on latency and errors; the staging gating runs full attestation validation which caught this. Good catch.

sam: choices: 1) wait for mirror to re-write attestation (not reliable), 2) republish with canonical manifest and pin digest (preferred), 3) create a new tag and do manual canary under it then update release notes. Also consider scheduling a short change window for a coordinated cross-region republish to avoid double writes.

nina: prefer option 3: publish as 6.1.0-pin1 in us-gcr only, re-sign attestation with same KMS, and run canary. Keep original 6.1.0 frozen until postmortem.

oliver: plan: pull blobs from primary, canonicalize manifest (sort entries + normalize digests), push 6.1.0-pin1 with explicit manifest digest to us-gcr, cosign attest, and update deploy-bot mapping for canary. I'll queue manual_republish.

deploy-bot: action queued: manual_republish_request by oliver for build_id=202603240830.

oliver: pulled blobs, verified build_id matches; canonical manifest created. pushing to us-gcr as redwood/api:6.1.0-pin1 -> digest sha256:11cc00... attaching attestation.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: republish complete. registry_manifest(us-gcr)=sha256:11cc00... attestation attached.

qa-bot: running full provenance lint + canary smoke on 6.1.0-pin1. will report within 15m.

support: tagging support channels and docs: we'll include a short blurb in release-notes: "6.1.0 republished as 6.1.0-pin1 in US due to mirror normalization; original tag frozen pending audit." Also notifying on-call for the change window.

pete: decision: DO NOT promote original 6.1.0. Promote 6.1.0-pin1 to canary for US region only, run gradual rollout if QA green. schedule a 10m change window at 09:30 UTC to finish cross-region sync and avoid simultaneous mirror writes. Add follow-up ticket to add early provenance validation in the CI pipeline before mirror copy.

sam: agreed. I'll update the release checklist, add the change-window to the calendar invite, and file the follow-up ticket for CI gating. good job catching this. Logging thread into the release audit. :thumbsup:
